title: Connections
description: Get your tickets into cTrader, MetaTrader 4/5, Alpaca or Interactive Brokers.

noOrders.title: Levelset never connects to your broker or sends orders
noOrders.body: You copy, export or send the ticket to your platform, and you place the order yourself there. Every trade is your decision.

card.bridgeHint: A cBot / EA that shows the ticket inside the platform for you to confirm.
card.apiHint: Send the order through the platform's API, with your confirmation on every order.

ctrader.name: cTrader
steps: Find the symbol in the Watchlist search. Brokers often name stock CFDs differently (for example TSLA.US or Tesla).
Open the order ticket: click the symbol and choose New Order (or press F9).
Choose Market Order and the side: Buy or Sell.
Enter the quantity. Check whether this symbol is traded in shares, units or lots at your broker.
Turn on Stop Loss, switch it to Price (not pips) and paste the stop loss.
Turn on Take Profit, switch it to Price and paste the take profit.
Click Place Order, then check the Positions tab shows the stop loss and take profit.
If neither level is hit, close the position yourself by the flat-by time.
ctrader.note: Some brokers only accept the stop loss and take profit as a distance in pips. Then use the difference between the entry and each level.

mt4.name: MetaTrader 4
steps: In Market Watch, right-click and choose Symbols to find your broker's CFD for the stock.
Right-click the symbol and open Specification to check the contract size (1 lot may be 1 share or 100).
Double-click the symbol (or press F9) to open the Order window.
Set Type to Market Execution and enter the Volume in lots.
Paste the stop loss into Stop Loss and the take profit into Take Profit.
Click Buy by Market (or Sell by Market).
Open the Terminal (Ctrl+T), Trade tab, and check the S/L and T/P columns.
If neither level is hit, close the position yourself by the flat-by time.
mt4.note: If your account uses instant execution and won't accept S/L and T/P on a market order, open the position first, then right-click it and choose Modify order to add them.

mt5.name: MetaTrader 5
steps: Open Market Watch (Ctrl+M) and find your broker's CFD symbol for the stock.
Right-click the symbol, choose Specification and check the contract size and volume step.
Press F9 (New Order) or double-click the symbol.
Choose Market Execution (or Instant Execution) and enter the Volume in lots.
Paste the stop loss into Stop Loss and the take profit into Take Profit.
Click Buy by Market (or Sell by Market).
Open the Toolbox (Ctrl+T), Trade tab, and check the S/L and T/P columns.
If neither level is hit, close the position yourself by the flat-by time.
mt5.note: Fractional volumes depend on the broker's volume step. Round the quantity to a size your broker accepts and re-check the max loss.

alpaca.name: Alpaca
steps: Sign in to the Alpaca dashboard and make sure you are in the account you mean to use (Paper or Live).
Search for the ticker and open the trade panel.
Choose Buy (or Sell), order type Market, the quantity in shares and time in force Day.
If a bracket (take profit + stop loss) option is offered, pick it and enter the take profit limit price and the stop loss stop price.
Review the order and submit it.
Check the Orders list: the take profit and stop loss orders should be waiting.
If neither level is hit, close the position yourself by the flat-by time.
alpaca.note: Without a bracket option, place the stop and the take profit as separate orders after the fill, and cancel the other one when one of them fills.

ibkr.name: Interactive Brokers
steps: In Trader Workstation (TWS), enter the ticker in Order Entry and pick the stock (SMART routing).
Choose Buy (or Sell), then open Attach and select Bracket Order.
Parent order: type MKT, quantity in shares, time in force DAY.
Profit taker: LMT at the take profit. Stop loss: STP at the stop loss.
Click Submit and review the order confirmation.
Check Orders / Activity: the two attached orders should be working.
If neither level is hit, close the position yourself by the flat-by time.
ibkr.note: In the IBKR mobile app or Client Portal, look for Attach Orders / Bracket when you create the order.

bridges.title: In-platform bridges
bridges.intro: Levelset writes the ticket to a folder. The bridge (a cBot or EA you install) shows it on your chart, and an order is placed only when you click Place there.

folder.label: Signals folder
folder.hint: Keep the default for MetaTrader: MT4 and MT5 can only read the terminal's Common Files folder (…\MetaQuotes\Terminal\Common\Files\Levelset). The cTrader cBot can read any folder.
folder.invalid: Enter an absolute path, for example C:\Users\you\AppData\Roaming\MetaQuotes\Terminal\Common\Files\Levelset.

ctrader: In Levelset, enable cTrader here and note the signals folder above.
Get bridges/ctrader/LevelsetBridge.cs from the Levelset repository (github.com/MauricioRodCar/Levelset).
In cTrader open Automate, create a new cBot named LevelsetBridge, paste the whole file and click Build.
Add the cBot to any chart. Leave Signals folder empty for the default, or paste the folder shown above.
Start it and allow Full Access when cTrader asks (it only reads and writes files in the signals folder).
The status here turns Online within 10 seconds.
mt5: In MetaTrader 5 choose File > Open Data Folder and open MQL5\Experts.
Copy bridges/mt5/LevelsetBridge.mq5 from the Levelset repository there.
Open it in MetaEditor (F4) and click Compile: it must finish with 0 errors.
In the Navigator, refresh Expert Advisors and drag LevelsetBridge onto any chart. Keep InpFolder = Levelset.
Turn on Algo Trading in the toolbar, otherwise Place can't send the order.
Enable MetaTrader 5 here and keep the default signals folder. The status turns Online within 10 seconds.
mt4: In MetaTrader 4 choose File > Open Data Folder and open MQL4\Experts.
Copy bridges/mt4/LevelsetBridge.mq4 from the Levelset repository there.
Open it in MetaEditor (F4) and click Compile: it must finish with 0 errors.
In the Navigator, refresh Expert Advisors and drag LevelsetBridge onto any chart. Keep InpFolder = Levelset.
Turn on AutoTrading and allow live trading in the EA's Common tab.
Enable MetaTrader 4 here and keep the default signals folder. The status turns Online within 10 seconds.
install.safety: The bridge never places an order on its own: it only shows the panel. You click Place or Dismiss inside the platform.

map.title: Symbol mapping
map.intro: Brokers name stock CFDs differently (TSLA.US, #TSLA…). Add one row per platform and ticker. Volume = shares × volume per share, rounded down to the step, so the risk never grows.
map.lotsHint: cTrader counts units (usually 1 per share). MT4/MT5 count lots: volume per share = 1 ÷ contract size (contract 1 → 1, contract 100 → 0.01).
map.empty: No symbols mapped yet. Add a row for each ticker you trade.

errors.duplicate: This ticker already has a row for this platform

send.title: Send {{symbol}} to your platform
send.description: Levelset writes this ticket for the bridge. It appears on your chart with Place and Dismiss. Nothing is placed until you click Place inside the platform.
send.noPlatforms: No platform is enabled. Enable one under Connections > In-platform bridges.
send.sent: Sent to the platform. Confirm it there with Place or Dismiss.

ticket.label: In platform
ticket.cancelled: Removed from the platform panel. An order you already placed is not changed.

errors.ticket_not_ready: Only a ticket that passed the risk check can be sent.
errors.bridge_disabled: Enable the platform under Connections first.
errors.bridge_symbol_unmapped: This ticker has no symbol mapping for the platform. Add it under Connections.
errors.bridge_volume_too_small: The converted volume is below the symbol's minimum. Check the symbol mapping.
errors.bridge_folder_unwritable: Levelset can't write to the signals folder. Check the path and its permissions.
errors.bridge_not_sent: This ticket was not sent to a platform.
errors.validation_error: Some values are not valid. Please check and try again.
